title: Explainable Machine-Learning based Detection of Knee Injuries in Runners
abstract: arXiv:2602.11668v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Running is a widely practiced activity but shows a high incidence of knee injuries, especially Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (PFPS) and Iliotibial Band Syndrome (ITBS). Identifying gait patterns linked to these injuries can improve clinical decision-making, which requires precise systems capable of capturing and analyzing temporal kinematic data.   This study uses optical motion capture systems to enhance detection of injury-related running patterns. We analyze a public dataset of 839 treadmill recordings from healthy and injured runners to evaluate how effectively these systems capture dynamic parameters relevant to injury classification. The focus is on the stance phase, using joint and segment angle time series and discrete point values.   Three classification tasks are addressed: healthy vs. injured, healthy vs. PFPS, and healthy vs. ITBS. We examine different feature spaces, from traditional point-based metrics to full stance-pha

translated_title: 基于可解释机器学习的跑者膝部损伤检测
translated_abstract: 跑步是一项广泛开展的运动，但膝关节损伤的发生率较高，尤其是髌股疼痛综合征（PFPS）和髂胫束综合征（ITBS）。识别与这些损伤相关的步态模式可以改善临床决策，这需要能够捕捉和分析时间运动学数据的精确系统。本研究使用光学动作捕捉系统来增强对与损伤相关的跑步模式的检测。我们分析了一个包含839条来自健康和受伤跑者的跑步机记录的公开数据集，以评估这些系统捕捉与损伤分类相关的动态参数的有效性。研究重点在于支撑相，使用关节和节段角度时间序列以及离散点数值。研究解决了三个分类任务：健康与受伤、健康与PFPS、健康与ITBS。我们考察了不同的特征空间，从传统的基于点的指标到完整的支撑相特征（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究利用可解释的机器学习方法分析光学动作捕捉的跑步支撑相数据，实现了对跑者膝部损伤（包括髌股疼痛综合征和髂胫束综合征）的有效检测与分类。
en_tdlr: This study applies explainable machine learning to optical motion capture data of the running stance phase, enabling effective detection and classification of knee injuries (PFPS and ITBS) in runners.
